RG-ONC-002.text: For stage I breast cancer, time since completion of treatment sets the rating. Under 2 years: postpone. 2 to under 3 years: loading of 100%. 3 to under 5 years: loading of 50%. 5 years or more with no recurrence and clear surveillance: standard rates, loading of 0%.
RG-ONC-002.title: Breast cancer, stage I

RG-ONC-003.text: Stage II or higher is outside the pre-validated bands. Cases at 7 or more years from treatment with clear surveillance may be considered at a loading of 25% to 75%, but every such case requires medical officer review before a rating is confirmed.
RG-ONC-003.title: Breast cancer, stage II and above

RG-ONC-004.text: A rating under section 4 requires the pathology summary, the treating oncologist report confirming stage and completion date, and the most recent surveillance result. Any recurrence, metastasis or new primary at any time moves the case to decline or medical officer referral.
RG-ONC-004.title: Evidence required for a cancer rating
